changes: Implemented evidence-based advisory activation for candidate playbooks. playbook_auto_promotion_apply --apply now writes deterministic digest-bound recommend_activate evidence for otherwise eligible candidates, activates only candidates with explicit non-DONE-settlement helped exposure outcomes, verifies activation audit/runtime consumption, and serializes promotion-decision ledger writes with shared idempotency.
usage: Use lattice playbook_seed_observe / playbook_seed_propose_batch --apply / playbook_candidate_batch_approve --apply to create a candidate, record structured candidate exposure with lattice playbook_outcome_record, then run lattice playbook_auto_promotion_apply --apply --json and lattice playbook_runtime_consumption_verify --json.
expectedOutcome: A candidate with explicit candidate-inspection helped outcomes becomes an active advisory playbook and is runtime-consumed; candidates without explicit exposure, DONE-settlement-only rows, harmful/wrong-claim rows, stale digests, or duplicate lineage remain blocked.
actualTranscript: Real-machine evidence: lattice validate --story=B-6703 --json passed 32/32 configured commands; done_required_validate passed build and root npm test; playbook-seed-promotion-loop smoke passed 16/16; quorum_submit produced 3 valid local rounds over claude-cli and codex-cli.
outcomeDiff: No difference: expected evidence activation behavior matched the actual machine transcript.
limitations: No historical backfill, timer/daemon promotion, trial serving, blocking policy, or gate evidence is included. Activation remains advisory and non-authoritative, and still requires explicit candidate exposure plus structured outcome evidence.
pitfalls: Review found F-001: promotion sweep and auto apply initially wrote the same promotion-decision ledger through different locks. Fixed with a shared learning-store lock and append-level applied idempotency. done_prepare merged main and changed materialHash, so final local quorum had to be resubmitted over the post-merge material.
